text:
tess: Quick new ask percentile-stability probe for launch story. Not exhaustive  want a focused rerun on the long-tail (top 2% slowest) using 300 queries drawn from our tailwind slice. Need artifacts in 48h.

ranjeet: ok. define outputs and the success gate.

tess: deliverables: per-request CSV (req_id, latency_ms, tokens_in, tokens_out, model_tag), percentile deltas (p50/p90/p95/p99/p999), a small tail heatmap, runner_cmd.txt (redact keys), and a note about any fallback routing. Success: p99 stability within +/-10% vs baseline or flag for comms.

claire: add: include observed batch sizes and whether prefix/KV cache contributed. Also please attach the exact seed file link we used.

classpath? tess: seed link uploaded: https://redwood.co/samples/tailwind-300.csv. Baseline tag rw-large-v1:2026-03-10. Try quantized candidate rw-large-v1-q2_k for one trial if staging supports it. Runner example: curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $RWD_KEY' -d '{"model":"rw-large-v1:2026-03-10","input_file":"tailwind-300.csv","max_tokens":200,"stream":false}'

ranjeet: tagging runtimebot @runtimebot for slot and quantize availability. I can assemble slides if artifacts look good.

runtimebot: job queued id=jb_3180_tail. Estimated 2.8h on staging-gpu-4. Quantized path present; may fallback to rw-small under high contention.

runtimebot: job jb_3180_tail finished (2h42m). Artifacts saved: /artifacts/jb_3180_tail/ (tail_latency.csv, percentiles.csv, tail_heatmap.png, runner_cmd_redacted.txt, readme.txt). Metrics: mean_batch=3.2, cache_hit=8%. Quantized p99 = +21% vs baseline; baseline p99 stable within +3%. No hard failures.

claire: thanks. quantized delta >20% so we should not use in headline. Ranjeet can you prepare a 1-slide baseline summary and a 2-paragraph appendix noting quantization instability and routing behavior?

ranjeet: will do. ETA ~10h. I'll also add a short note for Sales about inbound lead messaging: stick to baseline numbers and point enterprise prospects to the appendix for quantization roadmap.

tess: perfect. marketing will lead with baseline percentiles and include the appendix for the webinar deep-dive. Closing loop unless SRE requests follow-up packaging changes. :thumbsup:
